name: dns_zone_transfer
description: DNS zone transfer attempt + full DNS enumeration (AXFR, subdomain brute-force via fierce-like logic).
author: james-linux

params.command: for ns in $(dig {{domain}} NS +short); do echo "--- AXFR from $ns ---"; dig @$ns {{domain}} AXFR 2>/dev/null; done

steps.description: Attempt zone transfer from each nameserver

params.command: for sub in www mail ftp admin portal vpn dev staging test api app shop blog wiki git svn cdn mx ns1 ns2 pop imap smtp cpanel webmail intranet internal beta; do result=$(dig +short $sub.{{domain}} A); [ -n "$result" ] && echo "$sub.{{domain}} -> $result"; done
echo '=== SPF/DKIM/DMARC ===' && dig {{domain}} TXT +short && dig _dmarc.{{domain}} TXT +short && dig default._domainkey.{{domain}} TXT +short
